definitions.start_idle_index: one-based control_step of first moving action; no motion = null
definitions.context: post-action snapshot at max(0,onset_control_step-32); gripper from command
definitions.leave_home_step: first control step with TCP >0.05m from frame0; null and never-left count if absent
definitions.post_release_resume_steps: per basket-entry transition, first subsequent TCP >0.05m from entry position; simultaneous fruit entries one event, re-entries included, unresumed entries right-censored
definitions.physical_observe_prefix: explicit observe_hold_steps=30 keeps physical frames0..30 and hold actions in the1300-step clock; history-only flags do not remove physical time; legacy pre-execution video frames remain excluded
definitions.open_before_first_detach: fourth residual class; includes open after detached loss
definitions.missing_metric: null; excluded only from its own metric denominator

clean.definition: Target attempt = one reach planning call, including rejected attempts; failure belongs to the target causing episode failure. left:y>.08, right:y<-.08, middle:closed interval; upper:z>=.54, lower:z<.54. Not all unvisited fruits in the layout.

DART.definition: Target attempt = one reach planning call, including rejected attempts; failure belongs to the target causing episode failure. left:y>.08, right:y<-.08, middle:closed interval; upper:z>=.54, lower:z<.54. Not all unvisited fruits in the layout.
